title: The Hollow Spire
author: Orsen Voss
blurb: Gideon Sandoval, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
